title: Small Prophets
predictedRatingReason: Predicted 3.5★: Mackenzie Crook's Detectorists follow-up: a lonely man in a shed grows truth-telling homunculi to learn if his vanished partner will return. Trakt 8.4 and Metacritic 87 say the craft is real, but gentle smile-not-laugh British comedy is where your solo bar bites: Ghosts 3★ (supernatural sitcom, 'a little bit funny') is the floor, Staged 4★ the ceiling. The missing-partner mystery is a spine Ghosts lacked; that is what would lift it to 4★. Six 29-min eps, Returning (S2 confirmed). Solo: a magical premise is the 'too silly for Helen' trigger. 2 episodes is enough to know.
predictedBingeabilityReason: Binge 4/5: Six episodes of ~29 minutes with one serialised question (does she come back, and what do the homunculi know) pulling through them — low commitment, finishable in two sittings. Not a 5: the register is gentle and melancholic, easy to put down between episodes rather than compulsive. Grabs from ep 1.
changeNote: New: Crook gentle magical-realist comedy; Ghosts-class solo hook risk, held at 3.5★
